steps.label: The problem
steps.sub: staging vs. prod need different settings, same image

steps.label: ConfigMap
steps.sub: a bag of key-value data, created separately from the Pod

steps.label: Same image, anywhere
steps.sub: config is injected at deploy time, not baked in

eyebrow: envFrom — every key becomes an env var
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: catalog-config
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  FEATURE_RECOMMENDATIONS: "true"
  DB_HOST: "catalog-db.default.svc.cluster.local"
---
spec:
  containers:
    - name: catalog
      envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: catalog-config
caption: One envFrom block injects every key in the ConfigMap as an environment variable.

eyebrow: Mounted as files — better for larger config
code:
volumeMounts:
  - name: nginx-conf
    mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
volumes:
  - name: nginx-conf
    configMap:
      name: catalog-nginx-conf
caption: Each key in the ConfigMap becomes a file in the mount path — the right fit for nginx.conf-style config.
